lines.en: In the name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate

lines.text: حمد و ثناي بي ريب و ريا قادر پر اسرار است که کلک صفت او اوراق افلاک را
lines.en: Praise and thanksgiving without doubt or hypocrisy is for the Capable One full of mysteries, whose pen of attributes [made] the leaves of the heavens

lines.text: بمقتضاي انا زينا السماء الدنيا بزينة الکواکب بارقام ثوابت و دراري
lines.en: according to 'We have adorned the lowest heaven with an adornment, the stars' with the figures of fixed stars and planets

lines.text: سياره مرقوم و مصور ساخت و شکر و سپاس بيحد و قياس حکيمي را رواست
lines.en: written and depicted, and boundless and immeasurable thanks and praise are fitting for a Wise One

lines.text: که دست قدرت او صفحه عالم خاک را بموجب والارض فرشناها فنعم الماهدون
lines.en: whose hand of power [made] the page of the earthly world according to 'And the earth We have spread out, and how excellently We have prepared it'

lines.text: بجداول انهار و علایم اشجار متجلي و مزين گردانيد مبتدعي که بسبب ترکيب نمودن
lines.en: manifest and adorned with the streams of rivers and the signs of trees, an Originator who by means of combining

lines.text: و به رتبه علياء و لقد کرمنا بني آدم رسانيد و بجهة مقاصد امم و مصالح بني آدم
lines.en: and brought to the exalted rank of 'And We have certainly honored the children of Adam', and for the sake of the purposes of nations and the interests of the children of Adam

lines.text: بحکم فرموده والشمس تجري لمستقر لها ذلک تقدير العزيز العليم گوي
lines.en: by the decree of the saying 'And the sun runs to its resting place; that is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing', the ball

lines.text: زرين آفتاب را درجات نهار و ليل و رخصت صعود و هبوط فرمود بجهة برام
lines.en: of the golden sun [in] the degrees of day and night, and permitted ascent and descent for the sake of the completion

lines.text: عبادات و نذر استطاعات کقوله تعالي والقمر قدرناه منازل حتي عادک
lines.en: of acts of worship and the vows of capabilities, as His exalted saying 'And the moon We have determined for it phases, until it returns like

lines.text: کالعرجون القديم مسرع سير او قمر را در قطع منازل و طي مراحل ازدياد و
lines.en: the old date stalk', hastening its course, the moon in traversing the phases and crossing the stages of increase and

lines.text: انتقاص نور تقدير نمود بيت فلک رقعه کلک تقدير اوست زمين حقه
lines.en: decrease of light He determined. Verse: The heaven is the paper of the pen of His determination, the earth is the box

lines.text: ملک تسخير اوست بيت هستي او بوک ده ات لب سفيدي روز و سياهي
lines.en: of the kingdom of His subjugation. Verse: His existence gives the kiss to the lip, the whiteness of day and the blackness

lines.text: شب تحيرت في وصف الاية وقصرت في شکر نعمائه و صلوة ناميات و
lines.en: of night. I am bewildered in describing the sign, and I fall short in thanking His bounties. And growing blessings and

lines.text: تحف تحيات زاکيات بقدر ادوار فلک دوار و نجه کواکب ثوابت و
lines.en: gifts of pure greetings, to the extent of the cycles of the revolving heaven and the stars of the fixed stars and

summary.headline: Preface on the Cosmic Creation
summary.text: Persian theological preface praising God as creator of the heavens, fixed stars, planets, earth, rivers, trees, sun, and moon. It cites Qur’anic verses on the adornment of the lowest heaven, human dignity, the sun’s course, and the moon’s phases, with verse describing heaven as the page of divine determination and earth as the vessel of dominion.
